We need both status and trial_date. We could call with details="status" and then again with details="trial_date", or maybe the function returns both if unspecified? We should do them sequentially. We'll call for XY1234 Los Angeles County Court status, then XY1234 Los Angeles County Court trial_date, then GH5678 Orange County Court status, then GH5678 Orange County Court trial_date.
